correctness.rationale: Conditioning on label i having no children imposes the separate restrictions U_j≠i for j>i, so the conditioned choices remain independent and uniform on their allowed sets. The probability telescopes to (i−1)/(n−1). Compression makes each allowed set the whole set of smaller surviving labels and leaves the original attachment U_i independent of the reduced tree. Reinsertion adds exactly one plus the chosen parent's depth. The expected path-length recursion gives E P_m=m(H_m−1); averaging the parent depth in the initial i−1 tree gives H_{i−1}−1. The conditional mean shift is H_{i−1}−H_{n−1}; multiplying by the leaf probability gives the exact covariance, including zero at i=n and the degenerate n=2 boundary. For N=n−1 and k=i−1 the adjacent difference of k(H_k−H_N) is 1−(H_N−H_k). It is strictly increasing and cannot vanish: a multi-term consecutive reciprocal sum has a unique denominator of maximal 2-adic valuation, making the numerator after LCM clearing odd with an even common denominator; a single term is less than 1. The first positive difference gives the unique minimum. Evaluating the threshold at k near xN for fixed x just below and above 1/e sandwiches its location, then the harmonic difference tends to one, giving both limits. The audit checked the unrestricted proof and read the finite checker, rather than running the frozen code.

originality.rationale: The comparison with aggregate earlier literature is sound, but two distinct inspected catalogue records supply material coverage. Record 622c8793c9c4 gives the exact same fixed-birth-label covariance and conditional mean, the adjacent difference, and the 1/e extremum asymptotics. Record 4e2828958fad gives stronger fixed-set conditional erasure; at a singleton, the untouched independent attachment choice and deterministic depth increment immediately give the path-length law. The exact finite minimizer is the sign change of the already stated difference, with the classical consecutive-reciprocal nonintegrality excluding a tie. No distinct substantive remainder of the frozen claim is established against this combined coverage. These records carry later displayed dates: this is a statement-level coverage decision in the available catalogue, not a finding that either preceded the frozen work, nor a conclusion about priority or independent discovery.
residual_risks: No earlier direct match surfaced in the bounded primary literature search. The material matches are distinct records with later displayed dates; neither chronology of derivation nor priority is adjudicated.

value.rationale: The fixed-label conditional tree law is a meaningful structural object and the marked path covariance answers a question hidden by the aggregate: which birth age most strongly modifies total path length and by how much.
